cases.raw_symptoms: Patient have fever from 6 days and runny nose. Also has pain in stomach and experiencing vomiting after food.

general.symptom: Acute febrile state with gastrointestinal disturbance

concomitants: Vomiting occurring specifically after food intake during a febrile state
categorised.clinical_summary: An acute case presenting with a six-day febrile illness accompanied by catarrhal symptoms and gastric irritability manifesting as post-prandial emesis.

cases.clinical_notes: The fundamental disturbance is a state of acute gastric intolerance during a febrile process, where the stomach rejects all intake. The strange, rare, and peculiar feature is the specific modality of vomiting occurring immediately post-prandial during the febrile state, indicating a spasmodic contraction of the stomach lining.
